'''''Campanula portenschlagiana''''', the '''wall bellflower''',<ref name = RHSPF/> is a [[species]] of [[flowering plant]] in the [[Family (taxonomy)|family]] Campanulaceae, [[native plant|native]] to the Dalmatian Mountains in [[Croatia]]. It is a vigorous, low-growing, mound-forming [[evergreen]] [[perennial plant|perennial]] with deep purple flowers in summer.<ref name=RHSAZ>{{cite book|title=RHS A-Z encyclopedia of garden plants|year=2008|publisher=Dorling Kindersley|location=United Kingdom|isbn=1405332964|pages=1136}}</ref> Other [[common name]]s include '''Dalmatian bellflower''', '''[[Adria]] bellflower''' and '''Campanula muralis'''.

==Description==
The plant forms a mat of foliage about {{convert|10|cm|0|abbr=on}} high and {{convert|50|cm|0|abbr=on}} or more wide, with many heart- or kidney-shaped leaves. Deep purple or blue, funnel-shaped, 5-petalled flowers, {{convert|2|cm||1|abbr=on}} long, are borne in profusion, completely covering the plant from mid- to late summer.<ref name=RHSAZ />

Flowers may be pollinated by beetles, flies, bees and butterflies, but are also capable of [[self-pollination|self-pollinating]].

The Latin [[Botanical name#Binary name|specific epithet]] ''portenschlagiana'' commemorates the Austrian naturalist [[Franz von Portenschlag-Leydermayer]] (1772–1822).<ref name=RHSLG>{{cite book|last=Harrison|first=Lorraine|title=RHS Latin for gardeners|year=2012|publisher=Mitchell Beazley|location=United Kingdom|isbn=9781845337315|pages=224}}</ref>

==Cultivation and uses==
''Campanula portenschlagiana'' is an alpine plant requiring sharp drainage, so is suitable for an [[alpine garden]], [[rock garden]], or as [[groundcover]], in sun or partial shade.<ref>{{cite web|title=BBC Plant finder - Dalmatian bellflower|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/gardening/plants/plant_finder/plant_pages/4729.shtml|accessdate=24 June 2013}}</ref> Given suitable conditions, it will rapidly colonise cracks and crevices in walls and pavements. It is hardy to USDA [[hardiness zone]] 3.<ref>{{cite web | url = https://hardiness.zone/?a=plant&sle=Campanula&art=portenschlagiana | title = Campanula portenschlagiana | publisher = hardiness.zone | accessdate = 15 August 2020}}</ref>

This plant has gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]].<ref name = RHSPF>{{cite web|title=RHS Plant Selector - ''Campanula portenschlagiana''|url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/25642/Campanula-portenschlagiana/Details | accessdate=15 April 2020}}</ref>
